instruction: Remove the star from all emails in the Bills folder

rules.sql: select count(*) = 0 from messageAttributes where attributeID = 58 and value = 1 and messageID in (select id from messages where folderID = 13);

metadata.explanation: Task requires removing all stars from emails in the Bills folder (folderID=13). The evaluator checks that NO emails in folder 13 have the star attribute (attributeID=58) set to 1. This is verified via SQL query on the Thunderbird global-messages-db.sqlite database, ensuring count is 0.
